title: The closed gate — the Lord passes through
english: [[This gate shall remain shut; no one shall enter by it, for the Lord, the God of Israel, has entered by it >> Bible:Ezekiel 44:2]]. Ezekiel maps many temple gates for those who have ears.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Hear the allegory; glory Amen — SERIES
english: Again for [[those who have ears to hear >> Bible:Matthew 11:15]]: the Lord’s passing seals the gate — a mystery kept for the church. Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).
